name: epoch
description: Epoch workspace for core SDK, CLI, and WASM hosts.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @epoch/core && npm run build -w @epoch/cli && npm run build -w @epoch/wasm && npm run build -w @epoch/wasm-react && npm run build -w @epoch/integration-core && npm run build -w @epoch/react && npm run build -w @epoch/gen-ui && npm run build -w @epoch/redux && npm run build -w @epoch/xstate && npm run build -w @epoch/platform-core && npm run build -w @epoch/platform-sdk && npm run build -w @epoch/platform-web && npm run build -w @epoch/community-core && npm run build -w @epoch/community-api && npm run build -w @epoch/community-web && npm run build -w @epoch/community-operations-web && npm run build -w @epoch/community-cli && npm run build -w @epoch/sample-hello-world-cli && npm run build -w @epoch/sample-self-evolving-canvas && npm run build -w @epoch/sample-self-evolving-dashboard && tsgo -p tsconfig.test.json
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @epoch/core && npm run typecheck -w @epoch/cli && npm run typecheck -w @epoch/wasm && npm run typecheck -w @epoch/wasm-react && npm run typecheck -w @epoch/integration-core && npm run typecheck -w @epoch/react && npm run typecheck -w @epoch/gen-ui && npm run typecheck -w @epoch/redux && npm run typecheck -w @epoch/xstate && npm run typecheck -w @epoch/platform-core && npm run typecheck -w @epoch/platform-sdk && npm run typecheck -w @epoch/platform-web && npm run typecheck -w @epoch/community-core && npm run typecheck -w @epoch/community-api && npm run typecheck -w @epoch/community-web && npm run typecheck -w @epoch/community-operations-web && npm run typecheck -w @epoch/community-cli && npm run typecheck -w @epoch/sample-hello-world-cli && npm run typecheck -w @epoch/sample-self-evolving-canvas && npm run typecheck -w @epoch/sample-self-evolving-dashboard && tsgo -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit
scripts.features: npm run build -- --pretty false && npm run test:features:runtime
scripts.test:runtime: npm run test:unit:runtime && npm run test:features:runtime
scripts.coverage: npm run build -- --pretty false && c8 npm run test:runtime
scripts.test: npm run build -- --pretty false && npm run test:runtime
scripts.verify: npm run docs:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run konsistent && npm test && npm run coverage
